Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Frédéric Bastiat (author, Wikidata Q13515), died 1850; Prosper Paillottet (editor, Wikidata Q18115714), died 1878. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Bastiat, Frédéric, 1801-1850; Paillottet, Prosper, 1804-1878 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Œuvres complètes de Frédéric Bastiat, tome 6 : Harmonies économiques, 2015, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bastiat-oc-6. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 93%, 94%, 53% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Prosper Paillottet, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
